name: dariussbezy's Plugins (Testing)
description: Test builds of dariussbezy's plugins for Valenced.

dariuss.advanced-message-logger.name: Adv. Message Logger
dariuss.advanced-message-logger.description: Review edited and deleted messages in a local journal, in chat and in settings. Other plugins can build on it.
dariuss.advanced-message-logger.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.ghost-ping-logger.name: Ghost Ping Logger
dariuss.ghost-ping-logger.description: Find deleted or edited mentions and replies in the journal of Adv. Message Logger and get alerted about them.
dariuss.ghost-ping-logger.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.jump-to-ping.name: Jump to Ping
dariuss.jump-to-ping.description: Find unread mentions, replies and DMs, then jump straight to the message.
dariuss.jump-to-ping.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.midnight-theme.name: Midnight Mobile
dariuss.midnight-theme.description: Midnight for Discord mobile: navy panels, blue accents, Figtree, the moon icon and an optional outline icon pack.
dariuss.midnight-theme.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.no-tap-mention.name: No Tap Mention
dariuss.no-tap-mention.description: Disable tapping a message author's name to insert a mention.
dariuss.no-tap-mention.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.quick-translate.name: Quick Translate
dariuss.quick-translate.description: Translate messages and drafts with Google, Microsoft, DeepL or Groq AI.
dariuss.quick-translate.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.spotify-controls.name: Spotify Controls
dariuss.spotify-controls.description: Control Spotify from a Quest-style player above the YouBar.
dariuss.spotify-controls.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.voice-messages-to-text.name: Voice Messages To Text
dariuss.voice-messages-to-text.description: Transcribe voice messages below the audio, with a free server or Groq.
dariuss.voice-messages-to-text.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.no-delete-confirmation.name: No Delete Confirmation
dariuss.no-delete-confirmation.description: Delete messages without the confirmation dialog.
dariuss.no-delete-confirmation.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.message-actions.name: Message Actions
dariuss.message-actions.description: Reorder or hide the buttons shown when you long-press a message.
dariuss.message-actions.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.quick-react.name: Quick React
dariuss.quick-react.description: Choose and reorder the quick reaction emojis shown when you long-press a message.
dariuss.quick-react.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.music-controls.name: Music Controls
dariuss.music-controls.description: Control Spotify, YouTube Music and SoundCloud from a player above the YouBar. Spotify works on Android and iOS; YouTube Music and SoundCloud need the Music Controls app on Android.
dariuss.music-controls.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.performance-monitor.name: Performance Monitor
dariuss.performance-monitor.description: Measures how much time each plugin takes on Discord's JavaScript thread, so you can find the ones that slow Discord down.
dariuss.performance-monitor.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.bulk-downloads.name: Bulk Downloads
dariuss.bulk-downloads.description: Save every attachment, GIF and embedded photo or video of a message at once from its long-press menu.
dariuss.bulk-downloads.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.show-blocked.name: Show Blocked
dariuss.show-blocked.description: Shows messages from blocked and ignored users in servers, threads and group chats as normal messages, without the collapsed group or the Show message tap. Optional in group chats and DMs.
dariuss.show-blocked.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.transparent-youbar.name: Transparent YOUBAR
dariuss.transparent-youbar.description: Turns the YouBar into transparent: a translucent, tinted bar with a thin light border, a soft top highlight and a soft shadow. Works on Android and iOS, in dark and light themes.
dariuss.transparent-youbar.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.no-onboarding-delay.name: No Onboarding Delay
dariuss.no-onboarding-delay.description: Skips the slow waits and animation delays in server onboarding.
dariuss.no-onboarding-delay.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")

dariuss.better-toasts.name: Better Toasts
dariuss.better-toasts.description: Choose how long Discord's pop-up toasts stay, and make a new toast replace the old one.
dariuss.better-toasts.author: dariussbezy <908767091522420817> (https://github.com/dariussbezy "GitHub")
